symptom: A NativePhone home page on a layout with showbottombar: true that is not a bottom bar item passed check and exec; mx check then failed with CE6108 (ako/mxcli#2560, mendixlabs/mxcli#1931).
cause: No check read the home page's layout; and ListLayouts never read NativeLayoutContent.ShowBottomBar back (it was only written), so a stored layout always looked bar-less.
fix: For a native profile, each home page (default and per role, stated or kept from storage) whose layout — from the script or the project — shows the bottom bar and is not a bar item's page (stated items or the kept ones) is a reference error in check -p and in exec.
insight: A field the writer sets but the reader never fills reads as its zero value, so every rule built on the reader is silently off; grep for the getter in the reader whenever a rule depends on a property. Measured on 11.14.0 TestApp: the refused shape gives CE6108 and the control (home page in the bar) does not; both carry the fixture's CE4271/CE6078 that any native profile there brings.
test: mdl/executor/validate_native_home_bottombar_2560_pedapp_test.go (refused, home in bar, bar-less layout, layout and page from the same script); failed before the fix (check and exec accepted)
